title: ElevenLabs launches an album of original tracks made by artists like Liza Minnelli and Art Garfunkel in "collaboration" with its Eleven Music AI model (Todd Spangler/Variety)
summary: Todd Spangler / Variety: ElevenLabs launches an album of original tracks made by artists like Liza Minnelli and Art Garfunkel in “collaboration” with its Eleven Music AI model — Several well-known music artists have turned to ElevenLabs' AI as a virtual muse — and record producer.
